infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Lex records voice notes that you choose to add to your private legal intake.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Lex uses the camera only when you choose to photograph supporting evidence.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Lex accesses only the evidence you choose from your photo library.

plugins.microphonePermission: Allow Lex to record a voice note for your private legal intake.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow Lex to add selected evidence to your private legal intake.
plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Lex to photograph evidence you choose to submit.
